SampleCoordinateSystemDescription: Binocular gaze position in the Pupil Labs world (scene) camera image, normalized to the scene-camera frame (gaze_positions norm_pos_x/norm_pos_y), origin bottom-left, range [0,1]. Head-mounted scene camera - NOT mapped to the stimulus screen (no surface/marker tracking), so the coordinates are head-relative. The gaze estimate is binocular and is therefore identical in the eye1/eye2 files; only pupil_size / pupil_size_px (and confidence) are per-eye.
Description: Continuous pupillometry (right eye) with binocular gaze for task-video, Pupil Labs Pupil Core. pupil_size/pupil_size_px/confidence are for the right eye; x_coordinate/y_coordinate are the binocular gaze point in the world (scene) camera (n/a where gaze was not usable).

timestamp.Description: Time since the start of this task segment.

x_coordinate.Description: Binocular gaze x in the world (scene) camera image (Pupil gaze_positions norm_pos_x), origin bottom-left; n/a where gaze confidence < 0.6 or no gaze was recorded.

y_coordinate.Description: Binocular gaze y in the world (scene) camera image (Pupil gaze_positions norm_pos_y), origin bottom-left; n/a where gaze confidence < 0.6 or no gaze was recorded.

pupil_size_px.Description: Pupil diameter in the eye-camera image (2D).

confidence.Description: Pupil detector confidence [0,1]; 0 means ignore the sample.

TimeReference: pupil-clock (Pupil Player timestamps). NOT synchronized to EEG.
